title: Brauer Groups of Tame Stacky Curves
statement: Compute the Brauer group of an arbitrary tame stacky curve over an algebraically closed field.

**Status:** partially solved

**Assessment.** General tools now compute many tame stacky-curve Brauer groups, including broad algebraically closed-field and modular-curve cases, but the unrestricted question as stated is not a single completed classification.
